QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_2

question.text: Lotus India AIF's compliance officer, Mr. Ramesh Iyer, must submit the fund's ACTIVITY REPORT to SEBI through the Intermediary Portal. Under the prevailing SEBI reporting framework, the filing deadline is:

answer.text: Within 15 calendar days from the end of each month
Within 30 calendar days from the end of each quarter
Within 7 working days from the end of each quarter
Within 10 calendar days from the end of each quarter

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Regulation 28 and SEBI's reporting framework, every AIF must file its quarterly activity report through the SEBI Intermediary Portal within 10 calendar days from the end of the quarter. Category III AIFs additionally file a quarterly leverage report in the same window. The Trap: 15 days monthly is not the prescribed cadence for AIF activity reports. 30 days and 7 working days do not match the SEBI deadline for this filing. Note: The 10-day quarterly filing applies to all AIFs. Other returns and disclosures (for example, the Compliance Test Report) operate on separate timelines and should not be confused with this activity-report deadline.
